basis_integrity.finding: The served tape_conditions store SWITCHES from nymex_cont_n0 to nymex_cont_n1 on 20260618 and 20260619.
basis_integrity.mechanism: forecast_harness._tape_day_stats selects the MORE ACTIVE of the n0/n1 continuation stores for that day ('front proxy, basis-robust'). n0 is the OI-continuous front and, per contract_structure at the anchor vintage (open_interest_front NGN26 338,151 vs open_interest_next NGQ26 156,226, closing at ~14.4k/day), NGN26 stays the OI front past 06-19. So n0 = NGN26 (my forecast leg) all block and n1 = NGQ26. The switch means NGQ26 OUT-TRADED NGN26 on 06-17 and 06-18 - the July->August roll.
basis_integrity.corroboration_that_this_is_real_and_not_: The thinning is sustained and mirrored, which a truncated pull would not be: NGN26 volume steps down on 06-15 and never recovers through its own expiry while NGQ26 rises in mirror; unsided_volume_frac (side 'N', which carries implied/spread prints) triples from 0.073-0.099 in week 1 to 0.216-0.228 in week 2, the signature of roll/spread flow; L1 spread_ticks_med doubles 1.0 -> 2.0 over the same boundary; and every week-2 session still spans a full ~24h (span 1,423-1,442 min from n_trades/trades_per_min), so no session is truncated. This is a real liquidity migration, not an absent block.
basis_integrity.consequence_declared: 0611's D-1 (06-10) is on n0 = NGN26 = the forecast leg: CLEAN. 0618's D-1 (06-17) is on n1 = NGQ26: a DIFFERENT CONTRACT from the one I am forecasting. During a roll a crowded short that is de-risking BUYS the expiring front and SELLS the next, so a sell lean in NGQ26 is mechanically produced by the same act that buys NGN26. The n1 big-print reading of 0.305 on 16 prints is therefore confounded in a known direction AND thin. I DECLINED it as a directional tell on 0618 rather than reading it either way. I did not use its coherent-with-UP reading as evidence either - that would be having it both ways.
basis_integrity.not_a_stop_and_ask: The state DECLARES source_store per day and the harness comment states the selection rule, so this is disclosed behaviour rather than a silent hole of the S107 class. I am recording it because it changes what my second day's flow channel is worth, and because the group config's 'Leg NGN26' and the served store disagree for two sessions.

The positioning channel abstains too (extreme but improving WoW = spent fuel, no p50 sign). What is left, and it all points the same way weakly: the block-anchor absorption tell (3,916 lots of sell with a -2,386 closing phase and big prints at 0.352, yet a last hour that closed UP = absorbed sell = covering, UP), a consensus-implied storage trajectory sitting at/just below the seasonal norm, regional storage tightening including salt, nuclear chg_7d still positive, burn rising, and a forward balance that tightens through July. On MAGNITUDE I apply the leg-vs-net split the print play insists on: the print LEG is up-sized (path peaks +570 intraday) but the DAY NET is damped to +420 because there is no chain to deliver it and the D-1 is incoherent - the 1002/0326 form where the leg is real and the net is not. +420 is ~0.38 of the served n0_net_sigma_5 of 1,117; I did not go lower despite the weak read precisely because that sigma is declared biased low on catalyst days.

days.selection_reason: This is the day the G20 post-mortem was written for, and its generator fires here on its OWN stated preconditions rather than by analogy. A crowded short at a FRESH one-year extreme (2.83rd pctile) that is STILL ADDING (WoW -7,763) faces four de-risk deadlines inside one session: the 10:30 binary, a three-day Juneteenth weekend, opex T-4 and expiry T-5 - in a front-month book that has thinned ~5x with the spread doubled. The de-risk cannot wait for 10:30 and cannot be done in the overnight; it dates to the first liquid window, ~06:00. A second, independent, open-time channel agrees: structure.accumulation_arm_turn fires literally and guard-clean on 06-11 (0.572 / 160 prints) and 06-12 (0.597 / 68 prints) under sub-0.50 session tapes, and 06-12 closed with a +2,865 final-phase bid. selector.midblock_right_the_ship's two named triggers are both satisfied and its instruction is to take the sign to the turn side. MAGNITUDE, derived and stated: start at the served n0_net_sigma_5 of 1,117; a directional catalyst day with a live generator earns ~0.7 sigma = ~780; magnitude.catalyst_condition_sort COMPOUNDS stacked catalyst conditions and there are four here, which moves it one class step to ~950; the thin book amplifies on a delivery day rather than damping it, so I did not scale down for thinness; and the served sigma is declared biased LOW on exactly this day class, so ~950 is if anything conservative. I stop at +950 rather than reaching higher because the bearish fundamental stack is genuinely strong and because the blind cannot confirm that the turn DELIVERED - only that the stack built, which is the G18 caveat on this very play. The band's lower bound of +50 is where that concession lives.

What carries the read is the size-weighted big-print channel across 06-11 and 06-12 - 0.572 on 160 prints and 0.597 on 68, both guard-clean, both under selling count tapes - plus the +2,865 closing-phase bid on 06-12. That is an absorber that is still present and a short that is still adding: the combination the pre-print de-risk window discharges.
